01 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Do you agree that studying ______ important?

02 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
① Love makes life beautifully.
② Reading books makes me happy.
③ We think that it will rain tomorrow.
④ Music makes studying more enjoyable.
⑤ The doctor said that you should get some rest.
choices: We think that it will rain tomorrow.
The doctor said that you should get some rest.

03 다음 밑줄 친 부붐의 성격이 나머지와 다른 것은?
① He said that he was tired.
② I know that she is a good doctor.
③ Do you know that he is my cousin?
④ Do you know that woman over there?
⑤ I heard that they moved to a new city.
choices: He said that he was tired.
I know that she is a good doctor.
Do you know that he is my cousin?
Do you know that woman over there?
I heard that they moved to a new city.

04 다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 들어갈 적절한 말을 쓰시오. (서술형)
신생님은 시험을 쉽게 만들었다.
→ The teacher ______ the test ______ .

questions.explainKo: 정답: I feel that this movie is boring. (답지 22쪽)
questions.promptEn:
05 다음 우리말에 맞도록 괄호 안의 단어들을 순서대로 배열하여 영작하시오. (서술형)
나는 이 영화가 지루하다고 느껴.
(this / that / I / feel / movie / boring / is)
accept: I feel that this movie is boring.

ⓒ He forgot today was her birthday.
ⓓ Cooking together makes the meal deliciously.
① 0개
② 1개
③ 2개

08 다음 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓒ에 공통으로 들어갈 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오. (서술형)
• I felt ⓐ ______ something is wrong.
• Please do not touch ⓑ ______ button.
• I said I didn’t like her, but ⓒ ______ isn’t true.

questions.promptEn:
[09-10] 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 적절한 것을 고르시오.
09 A: Do you know ______ tomorrow is Parents’ Day?
B: Yes, I do. I will try to make them happy.
① when
② this
③ where
④ that
⑤ which

[09-10] 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 적절한 것을 고르시오.
10 A: The movie made the kids ______ .
B: Yes, they liked the action scenes!
① excite
② excited
③ exciting
④ excitedly
⑤ to be exciting

questions.promptEn:
11 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ The book makes learning easily.
ⓑ Sunshine makes the day bright.
ⓒ Snacks don’t make us health.
ⓓ He doesn’t promise that he will help us.
ⓔ Do you believe him is telling the truth?
ⓕ The teacher said that the test would be hard.
① ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓓ
② ⓐ, ⓓ, ⓕ
③ ⓑ, ⓓ, ⓕ
④ ⓒ, ⓓ, ⓔ
⑤ ⓓ, ⓔ, ⓕ

questions.promptEn:
12 다음 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The news made ⓐ ______ nervous.
• He forgot ⓑ ______ met her before.
• Do you think ⓒ ______ will come to the party?
① he / me / them
② me / him / he
③ her / he / she
④ they / she / me
⑤ their / her / his

questions.promptEn:
13 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
① I know that he is a good singer.
② That we are friends are nice.
③ My parents made my life happy.
④ That he studies every day is true.
⑤ Cold weather makes my hands dry.
choices: I know that he is a good singer.
That we are friends are nice.
My parents made my life happy.
That he studies every day is true.
Cold weather makes my hands dry.

questions.explainKo: 정답: This funny movie made me so happy. (답지 22쪽)
questions.promptEn:
14 다음 [조건]에 맞게 우리말을 바르게 영작하시오. (서술형)
조건 1. funny와 so를 포함하고, 과거 시제로 쓸 것.
조건 2. 총 7단어로 쓸 것.
조건 3. 대·소문자 및 구두점에 유의할 것.

이 재미있는 영화가 나를 정말 행복하게 만들었다.
accept: This funny movie made me so happy.

introKo: 통과 80%. 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 14문항 고르기는 누르기만 하면 됩니다. 빈칸은 그 칸의 말만 쓰세요.
